color_system_mechanics.elevation_strategy: Semi-transparent white overlay sheets stacked over the base surface color to visually represent height in dark mode.

core_semantic_palette_mapping.primary: Main brand expression color used across headers and key actions.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.primary_variant: Darker or lighter alternative of the primary brand color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.secondary: Accent color for floating action components, selections, and highlights.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.secondary_variant: Alternative variant of the secondary accent color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.background: The underlying base color behind scrollable application content.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.surface: The structural sheet color applied to cards, sheets, menus, and dialogs.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.error: The functional color reserved exclusively for validation failures.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.on_primary: High contrast color safe for text/icons placed over the primary color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.on_secondary: High contrast color safe for text/icons placed over the secondary color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.on_background: High contrast color safe for text/icons placed over the background color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.on_surface: High contrast color safe for text/icons placed over the surface color.
core_semantic_palette_mapping.on_error: High contrast color safe for text/icons placed over the error color.
